title: Courier: Döttinger Höhe to Paddock station
briefing:
Dispatch: collect the parcel at Döttinger Höhe (E2.2, the social station on the B258 at Döttinger Höhe) and deliver it to Paddock station (E2.4, the station inside the Grand Prix paddock). About 10.2 km from the pit area over the Ring's service and public roads; turn round in the pit lane first - the lane ahead only leads onto the Nordschleife. This is paid work, not an exam: the limit is 31 minutes, a calm 50 km/h arrives with time to spare. Pay on delivery: 100 credits.
Gates are ordered drive-throughs within 30 m of each station; cargo, stopping, traffic, police and damage are not simulated.

provenance.source: docs/design/design-synthesis-draft.md section 4 (Jobs: realistic ETAs achievable even in eco mode at minimal wear) and docs/design/user-thoughts-economy.org (jobs moving things between places); ECON-1 starter job board, docs/econ1-implementation.md

route.note: Planned on the covered skeleton (every road 5 m or wider), clear of the Nordschleife's guard rails, the forest trunks and the station shells by 1.5 m, avoiding the grade-separated crossings the single-valued height field turns into walls; the first 24 m are a left U-turn inside the pit junction's rail gap because the spawn faces the one-way Nordschleife.

pay.method: round to 5 of (40 + 6 x driven km)

time_limit.method: ceil to the minute of 2 x the measured scripted seconds

provenance.adaptation: Station gates are 30 m drive-through spheres centred on the focus-table position (the B6 placeholder shell is solid, the forecourt road passes beside it); route gates are 20 m. No cargo, stopping, traffic, police, damage, tips, early-arrival bonus or simultaneous jobs are simulated. The ring scene drives the pad Boxster.

medals.method: ceil(measured scripted seconds * 1.05 / 1.25 / 1.50) for gold / silver / bronze
medals.run: Godot 4.7.2, headless fixed 60 Hz, fresh ring car at the pit spawn, shipped input_script, 2026-09-30; trace recorded by a temporary pure-pursuit pilot outside the repo (cruise 14 m/s, 2.5 m/s^2 lateral budget, one HandlingTests step per 0.1 s, idle steps merged) and replayed through the unchanged HandlingTests commands
